npcs.name: Biker1
npcs.meet_text: how the hell did you manage to speak to me??

npcs.name: Biker2
npcs.repeat_text: Unless you're just reading this in the npc data.

npcs.name: Biker3
npcs.meet_text: I guess this is an easter egg.

npcs.name: Biker4
npcs.meet_text: Does this make it more exciting if I add an egg.

npcs.name: Old Guy Neighbour Day 1
npcs.meet_text: Oh hello there neighbour! Have you just recently moved in next door? I believe the beach is closed today but you can still go and see the lighthouse. If you get your hands on a starter deck, everyone in this town loves playing the Pokemon Card game!
npcs.repeat_text: I'm just tidying up here, sadly I'm no good at cards, but there's always folk around the lighthouse to have a game with! If you've got some spare change, you can buy new cards from the Card Mart a few doors down from here.

npcs.name: Old Lady On Bench Day 1
npcs.meet_text: Hello! I'm not very good at the Pokemon card game so I gave my cards to my Grandson. He always says 'Weaknesses' and 'Resistances' are key Grandma, but I never understood it myself!.
npcs.repeat_text: If you always pay attention to a Pokemon's Weaknesses and Resistances then you'll always have a good chance of winning I believe. You can always buy new cards from the Card Mart and hope you get some good ones!

npcs.name: Policeman Blocking Beach
npcs.meet_text: We've currently got a large migration of Sharpedo passing through the harbour so it's not safe for anyone to be on the beach at the moment, it's going to be shut for the rest of the day but we'll reopen tomorrow.
npcs.repeat_text: Sorry if you came here to see the beach but we'll reopen it once all of the Sharpedo have passed through. They migrate this way once a year but they tend to go through pretty quick so should be gone by the morning.

npcs.name: Badman 1
npcs.meet_text: Heh, scram kid. We're having our biker gang meetup here so get lost.
npcs.repeat_text: Didn't you hear me? Get lost kid.

npcs.name: Car Park Guy 1
npcs.meet_text: I'm the parking warden for the Celeste Harbour car park but all these bikers have decided to take it over. I can't get rid of them by myself but the police are protecting the beach so I'm on my own.
npcs.repeat_text: I hope these bikers leave soon, they're causing a right ruckus for the harbour and it's not good for anyone else.

npcs.name: Badman 2
npcs.meet_text: We're called the Cool Guy Biker Gang. We're the coolest in the world..... What are you giggling at loser?

npcs.name: Man Staring Out To Sea
npcs.meet_text: Hello and welcome to the neighbourhood. Celeste Harbour is so serene. It's such a great place to live and got everything we need. Here take this as a welcome gift to help you get settled here.
npcs.repeat_text: Me and my girlfriend moved here recently too, It's always so quiet and the water is always warm. I don't think we'll ever leave.

npcs.name: Woman Staring Out To Sea
npcs.meet_text: I'm so glad we moved here. It smells like freshly cut grass and warm sea air every day here.
npcs.repeat_text: My husband is so kind and generous, we've already made a lot of great friends here.

npcs.name: Maintenance Guy Watering Sunflowers
npcs.meet_text: As much as I would love to have a game, I can't right now... My boss will get mad if I do while I'm on the clock. I've gotta water all of the flowers on this pier and it's gonna take me ages. I'm due to finish this evening.
npcs.repeat_text: I should be finished with this shortly, hopefully by this evening. As soon as I'm done with work I'll be up for a match. Come find me later when I've finished.

npcs.name: Maintenance Guy Fixing The Lighthouse
npcs.meet_text: I'm just about to replace the lighthouse bulb with a new one. It's a loooooonnnnng way to the top, probably about 10,000 steps! I'm getting too old to be doing this but it's an important job.
npcs.repeat_text: Weellll... it's not really 10,000 steps but it feels like that many. Can't let the lightbulb get worn out - If it does it'll mean a lot of trouble for the harbour so the responsibility is larger than the climb up!

opponents.name: Youngster Joey
opponents.meet_text: I just got given some cards off my grandma, she's so cool. I'm not really good at battling yet but it's a lot of fun!
opponents.first_win_text: Take these full heal cards, you can use them to heal any status conditions your pokemon get. They're really useful.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I'm going to win one day!
opponents.loss_text: I didn't expect to win at all! These cards must be really good.

opponents.name: Gambler Mick
opponents.meet_text: All I need is a bit of luck, I let that decide my fate. If I battle enough then I'm bound to win some of them at least.
opponents.repeat_text: I'll be a lot luckier this time round.
opponents.first_win_text: Luck really wasn't on my side today...
opponents.rematch_win_text: I just need a little bit of luck that's all.
opponents.loss_text: Looks like luck wasn't on your side today.

opponents.name: Schoolboy Adam
opponents.meet_text: I'm trying out some new techniques using statuses. If we battle I'll show you how good they are.
opponents.repeat_text: I'll definitely win this time round.
opponents.first_win_text: Oh man I really thought my statuses were going to cause you some trouble.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Maybe I need a better tactic...
opponents.loss_text: I knew my status infliction technique would work!

opponents.name: Fisherman Dave
opponents.meet_text: I love the lighthouse here, it seems to attract all kinds of fish so I always catch a lot in this spot. I'm catching so many I need a break.
opponents.repeat_text: I've caught a lot since last time.
opponents.first_win_text: Even if they don't help me win, I still love my fish.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Fishing and Pokemon cards are both a lot of fun, I could do both all day.
opponents.loss_text: Maybe you should try picking up a rod and give fishing a go instead!
